topic: League of Legends Worlds 2026: the knockout stage starts
tone: fun, for fans who missed the Swiss stage

sources.title: 2026 League of Legends World Championship: venues and format
sources.notes: Hosted in the United States, 15 October to 14 November 2026. Play-in at Riot Games Arena, Los Angeles (15-18 October). Swiss stage, quarterfinals and semifinals at the Credit Union of Texas Event Center in Allen, Texas. Final on 14 November at Barclays Center, Brooklyn, New York City. 19 teams. Swiss stage: 16 teams, three wins advance, three losses eliminated. Knockout stage: 8 teams, single elimination, all best-of-five. Base prize pool: 5,000,000 US dollars, 1,000,000 for the winner.

sources.title: 2026 League of Legends World Championship: Swiss stage results
sources.notes: Qualified for the knockout stage: Gen.G (Korea, 3-0), Dplus KIA (Korea, 3-0), T1 (Korea, 3-1), Invictus Gaming (China, 3-1), Top Esports (China, 3-1), Karmine Corp (Europe, 3-2), LYON (North America, 3-2), Bilibili Gaming (China, 3-2). Eliminated include G2 Esports (Europe, 1-3), Movistar KOI (Europe, 2-3) and Hanwha Life Esports (Korea, 2-3). T1 are the three-time defending world champions. LYON reached the Worlds playoffs for the first time.

sources.title: 2026 League of Legends World Championship: Karmine Corp
sources.notes: Karmine Corp (French organisation, LEC) played its first World Championship. It came through the play-in (beat Cloud9 KIA 3-2, then MVK Esports 3-0 twice). In the Swiss stage it beat Anyone's Legend, lost to LYON, lost to Bilibili Gaming, then beat CTBC Flying Oyster 2-0 and Movistar KOI 2-0 to qualify at 3-2. First knockout stage appearance for a French-based organisation since Against All Authority in 2011.

sources.title: 2026 League of Legends World Championship: quarterfinal schedule
sources.notes: Quarterfinals, best-of-five: 3 November Top Esports vs Invictus Gaming; 4 November Gen.G vs LYON; 5 November Dplus KIA vs Bilibili Gaming; 6 November Karmine Corp vs T1. Semifinals on 7 and 8 November. No quarterfinal result is known at the time of writing.
